definitions.explanation: A shop or store that is authorized to sell, service, or handle a particular product or brand. Commonly seen on signs and advertisements to indicate where specific products are available.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To look for the nearest authorized dealer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This product can be purchased at authorized dealers nationwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウェブサイト→ウェブサイト：05152_webusaito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I checked the list of retailers on the website before going to buy it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けられない→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some cases, you cannot receive a warranty unless you buy from an authorized dealer.

notes:
Composed of {取扱|とりあつかい} (handling, dealing) and ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop, store). This is a very common term in Japanese retail, appearing on storefronts, product packaging, and brand websites to indicate officially authorized points of sale.

The word implies that the shop has an arrangement — formal or informal — with the manufacturer or brand to sell their products. Buying from a {取扱店|とりあつかいてん} often ensures warranty coverage and authenticity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}: official authorized dealer
- {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of authorized dealers
- {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to search for dealers
- ⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}: nearest authorized dealer
- {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧: seeking authorized retailers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{販売店|はんばいてん}→販売店：20898_hanbaiten⟧: sales outlet, retail shop — a general term for any shop that sells something; does not imply authorization
- ⟦{代理店|だいりてん}→代理店：21690_dairiten⟧: agency, agent — a business that acts on behalf of another company, often with broader authority than a {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}
- {特約店|とくやくてん}: exclusive dealer, franchise — a shop with a special contract, often implying a closer or exclusive relationship with the brand
